pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Solutions tailored for governments, NGOs, and private health sector actors.
pricing.free_desc: Discover the platform with no commitment.
pricing.faq1_q: Can I cancel at any time?
pricing.faq1_a: Yes, no commitment. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account.
pricing.faq2_a: WHO data syncs daily (4 times per day). Disease-specific alerts fire within 8 hours of a new WHO detection.
pricing.faq3_a: Yes. The Free plan gives you access to the public dashboard, one monitored region and the weekly digest — no credit card required, no time limit.
pricing.faq4_q: What happens when my 14-day trial ends?
pricing.faq4_a: If you started your trial without entering a card, nothing happens — your account moves to the Free plan automatically, no charge. If you added a card, your subscription starts at the end of the trial. You can cancel at any time before that from your account.
pricing.faq5_q: Where does your data come from?
pricing.faq5_a: All outbreak data is sourced directly from official public health agencies: WHO, PAHO, and ECDC. We do not fabricate or estimate data — if an agency hasn't reported a figure, we display it as 'not reported' rather than guessing.
